theory.title: Preposiciones de movimiento y recorrido
theory.explanation: Usa preposiciones de movimiento para describir rutas con precisión: across a bridge (cruzando un puente), along a street (a lo largo de una calle), through a tunnel (por dentro de un túnel), past a building (pasando junto a un edificio), towards a station (hacia una estación) e into/out of (hacia dentro/fuera de un lugar).
theory.tip: Distingue movimiento por dentro (through), de un lado a otro (across) y siguiendo una línea (along).

patterns.label: Preposiciones de movimiento y recorrido · 1
examples:
Walk across the bridge.
→ Cruza el puente.

patterns.label: Preposiciones de movimiento y recorrido · 2
patterns.pattern: Go along the river until you see a café.
examples:
Go along the river until you see a café.
→ Sigue el río hasta que veas una cafetería.

patterns.label: Preposiciones de movimiento y recorrido · 3
patterns.pattern: The train passes through a long tunnel.
examples:
The train passes through a long tunnel.
→ El tren pasa por un túnel largo.

patterns.label: Preposiciones de movimiento y recorrido · 4
patterns.pattern: We walked past the town hall.
examples:
We walked past the town hall.
→ Pasamos por delante del ayuntamiento.

patterns.label: Preposiciones de movimiento y recorrido · 5
examples:
Head towards the main square.
→ Dirígete hacia la plaza principal.

patterns.label: Preposiciones de movimiento y recorrido · 6
patterns.pattern: The bus goes around the old town.
examples:
The bus goes around the old town.
→ El autobús rodea el casco antiguo.

patterns.label: Preposiciones de movimiento y recorrido · 7
patterns.pattern: She ran up the stairs to the platform.
examples:
She ran up the stairs to the platform.
→ Subió corriendo las escaleras hasta el andén.

patterns.label: Preposiciones de movimiento y recorrido · 8
patterns.pattern: They came down the hill slowly.
examples:
They came down the hill slowly.
→ Bajaron la colina despacio.

patterns.label: Preposiciones de movimiento y recorrido · 9
patterns.pattern: Walk into the station and turn left.
examples:
Walk into the station and turn left.
→ Entra en la estación y gira a la izquierda.

patterns.label: Preposiciones de movimiento y recorrido · 10
patterns.pattern: The path leads out of the village.
examples:
The path leads out of the village.
→ El camino sale del pueblo.

content.passage: To reach the castle from the station, walk across the main road and continue along King Street. Go past the library and turn towards the river. The footpath goes through a small park before leading up the hill. At the top, walk around the old tower and enter the castle through the main gate. The visitor centre is just inside, on your right.

items.prompt: Give directions from a station to a local attraction.
items.modelAnswer: I enjoy travelling because it gives me the chance to discover new places and understand different ways of life. One experience I remember clearly was a journey that did not go exactly as planned. At first, I felt a little worried, but I asked for information and found a practical solution. I learned that preparation is important, although it is also useful to stay flexible. In the future, I would like to explore more destinations and learn about their local traditions.

content.audioTranscript: A: We are planning a trip next month. B: Where are you going? A: We are travelling to a historic town. B: Have you booked the journey? A: Yes, and we have printed the tickets. B: Which station will you use? A: The central one. B: Is there a local guide? A: Yes, we made a booking online. B: Do you know the platform? A: It is shown on the app. B: What will you visit? A: The museum and the market. B: Are you learning about local customs? A: Yes, and we are staying at a small hotel. B: Enjoy your arrival!
